title: Creeper Nerf Plus
description: Reduces damage of creepers to half of vanilla, causes them to flee from players with torches which now emit light when held.
body: Creeper Nerf Plus makes creeper explosions do only half of normal damage to players, making surprise encounters less punishing. Creepers also now become afraid of players holding torches, offering an intuitive way to push them back without combat. This mod also causes torches to emit light when held in main or off-hand. In singleplayer your game is both server and client so everything works together automatically. But in multiplayer both player and server must have the mod installed.
